title: Apple vs. OpenAI: Former Employee Still Leaked Confidential Documents via Personal iCloud After Leaving

content_html:
The case of Apple suing OpenAI for stealing trade secrets is revealing a data management vulnerability in Apple's own backyard. According to U.S. tech media, due to loopholes in internal policies, some former Apple employees were still able to access confidential documents, including product release plans, through their personal iCloud accounts after leaving the company.

This discovery adds a new technical dimension to Apple's legal battle with OpenAI. The root of the problem lies in Apple's long-standing practice of encouraging employees to link their personal Apple IDs with company-issued iCloud spaces - the company provides 2TB of iCloud storage and allows it to be combined with existing personal plans. Since iPhones support only one primary Apple ID for full iCloud access, many employees ended up storing both work and personal files on the same device and account.

Apple is not completely unguarded. In the late 2010s, it introduced a "Apple Work" folder to manage work files; however, internal information outside this folder could still mix with personal data such as photos and continue to sync after employees left. In other words, the wall that should have prevented former employees from accessing company secrets had a gap in its account structure - when a person left, the company's confidential information remained in the account, waiting to be accessed at any time. A lawsuit against outsiders has instead exposed Apple's own data governance weaknesses to the outside world.

content_html_zh:
苹果起诉OpenAI窃取商业机密的案件暴露了苹果自家后院的数据管理漏洞。 据美国科技媒体报道，由于内部政策存在漏洞，一些前苹果员工在离开公司后仍然能够通过个人iCloud账户访问包括产品发布计划在内的机密文件。

这一发现为苹果与 OpenAI 的法律斗争增添了新的技术层面。 问题的根源在于苹果长期以来鼓励员工将个人Apple ID与公司发行的iCloud空间关联起来的做法——该公司提供2TB的iCloud存储空间，并允许其与现有的个人计划结合起来。 由于 iPhone 仅支持一个主 Apple ID 来实现完整的 iCloud 访问，因此许多员工最终将工作文件和个人文件存储在同一设备和帐户上。

苹果并非完全没有防备。 2010 年代末，它推出了“Apple Work”文件夹来管理工作文件；但是，此文件夹之外的内部信息仍可能与照片等个人数据混合，并在员工离开后继续同步。 换句话说，这堵本应阻止前员工接触公司机密的墙，在其账户结构上却出现了缺口——当有人离开时，公司的机密信息仍留在账户中，等待随时被访问。 针对外部人士的诉讼反而向外界暴露了苹果自身数据治理的弱点。
